description_en: Updates the definition of a specified agent and increments the definition version, with the option to publish immediately. This operation is available only when the canary release feature is enabled. Before calling this operation, ensure that the canary release feature is enabled for the current account and the target region
description_zh: 更新指定 Agent 的定义并递增定义版本，可选择立即发布。本接口需要开启灰度才可以使用。调用前请确认当前账号及目标地域已开启相应灰度
name: UpdateAgent

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent to be updated. Use the Name returned by GetAgent. This field is used to locate the target agent and is not used for renaming
parameters.help_zh: 待更新 Agent 的名称，使用 GetAgent 返回的 Name；本字段定位目标，不用于重命名
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The agent definition version used for concurrency control. Explicitly specify the AgentVersion obtained from GetAgent for each call. The update is rejected if the version does not match the current version on the server. To ensure compatibility with different deployment versions, do not rely on the server-side processing when this parameter is omitted
parameters.help_zh: 用于并发控制的 Agent 定义版本。建议每次调用都显式填写刚从 GetAgent 取得的 AgentVersion；与服务端当前版本不一致时拒绝更新。为兼容不同部署版本，不依赖省略此参数时的服务端处理
parameters.name: expected_version

parameters.help_en: The display name of the agent
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.example: 你是一名优秀的etl工程师。
parameters.name: system_prompt

fields.help_en: The name of the built-in toolset. This parameter is required when Kind is set to BUILTIN_TOOLSET. Use a name supported by the target server. Omit this parameter when Kind is set to MCP_TOOLSET
fields.help_zh: 内置工具集名称，Kind=BUILTIN_TOOLSET 时必填，使用目标服务端支持的名称；Kind=MCP_TOOLSET 时省略
fields.name: builtin_name

fields.help_en: The tool type. A valid tool reference must specify BUILTIN_TOOLSET or MCP_TOOLSET. For BUILTIN_TOOLSET, BuiltinName must also be specified. For MCP_TOOLSET, McpServerName must also be specified. The target server validates the reference based on the tool type
fields.help_zh: 工具类型。有效工具引用须填写 BUILTIN_TOOLSET 或 MCP_TOOLSET；前者需同时填写 BuiltinName，后者需同时填写 McpServerName。由目标服务端按工具类型校验
fields.name: kind

fields.help_en: The list of selected MCP tool names. If this parameter is omitted or an empty array is provided, no filtering by tool name is performed. Each item must be an actual tool name in the target service
fields.help_zh: 选用的 MCP 工具名称列表；省略或空数组表示不按工具名称筛选。每项必须是目标服务中实际存在的工具名称
fields.name: mcp_items

fields.help_en: The MCP service name. This parameter is required when Kind is set to MCP_TOOLSET. The service must be one that the current invoker has permissions to reference and that has an active published version
fields.help_zh: MCP 服务名称，Kind=MCP_TOOLSET 时必填，必须为当前调用者有权引用且具备可用发布版本的服务
fields.name: mcp_server_name

fields.help_en: A reserved field for the legacy model. Specifying only Name does not constitute a valid tool configuration and cannot replace Kind, BuiltinName, or McpServerName
fields.help_zh: 旧模型保留字段。单独填写 Name 不构成有效工具配置，不能代替 Kind、BuiltinName 或 McpServerName
fields.name: name

parameters.help_en: The list of tool references. Omit this parameter if no modification is required. The current new backend retains existing tools even for an empty array. A non-empty array replaces the references. Each item must include Kind and the corresponding configuration, and cannot include only Name. Replace the MCP service and tool names in the example with actual values available to the current identity
parameters.help_zh: 工具引用列表。不需要修改时省略；当前新后端对空数组也保留已有工具。非空数组替换引用，每项需填写 Kind 及对应配置，不能只填写 Name。示例中的 MCP 服务和工具名称应替换为当前身份可用的真实值
parameters.name: tools

fields.help_en: The name of the custom skill. Use the Name of a visible custom skill. For official skills, use SkillId
fields.help_zh: 自定义 Skill 名称，使用可见的自定义 Skill 的 Name；官方 Skill 使用 SkillId
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The resource ID of the official skill. This parameter is used when Source is set to OFFICIAL
fields.help_zh: 官方 Skill 的资源 ID，Source 为 OFFICIAL 时使用
fields.name: skill_id

fields.help_en: The source of the skill. OFFICIAL: official skill, used with SkillId. DB or omitted: custom skill, used with Name
fields.help_zh: Skill 来源。OFFICIAL：官方 Skill，搭配 SkillId；DB 或省略：自定义 Skill，搭配 Name
fields.name: source

fields.help_en: The published integer version number of the custom skill, used to explicitly select an existing version. Do not pass this field when Source is set to OFFICIAL. This parameter is mutually exclusive with VersionSelector
fields.help_zh: 自定义 Skill 的已发布整数版本号，用于明确选择已有版本。Source=OFFICIAL 时不要传此字段；不与 VersionSelector 同时传入
fields.name: version

fields.help_en: The semantic version selection expression of the custom skill, such as ^1.2.3. Use this parameter only when the target server has deployed the custom resource version selection capability. This parameter is mutually exclusive with Version. This field is not accepted when Source is set to OFFICIAL. To ensure compatibility with servers of unconfirmed versions, use an existing integer Version
fields.help_zh: 自定义 Skill 的语义版本选择表达式，例如 ^1.2.3。仅在目标服务端已部署自定义资源版本选择能力时使用，与 Version 互斥。Source=OFFICIAL 时不接受此字段。需要兼容未确认版本的服务端时，使用已有的整数 Version
fields.name: version_selector

parameters.help_en: The list of skill references. Omit this parameter if no modification is required. Do not use an empty array to indicate retention or clearing. For official skills, specify only Source=OFFICIAL and SkillId. Name, Version, VersionSelector, or client artifact fields are not accepted. For custom skills, specify Name, and you can explicitly specify an existing integer Version
parameters.help_zh: Skill 引用列表。不需要修改时省略，不用空数组表达保留或清空。官方 Skill 只填写 Source=OFFICIAL 与 SkillId，不接受 Name、Version、VersionSelector 或客户端制品字段；自定义 Skill 填写 Name，可显式指定已有的整数 Version
parameters.name: skills

fields.help_en: The source of the expert suite. OFFICIAL: official suite. DB or omitted: custom suite. Both types of references use SuiteId, and the version fields apply only to custom resources
fields.help_zh: 专家套件来源。OFFICIAL：官方套件；DB 或省略：自定义套件。两类引用均使用 SuiteId，版本字段仅适用于自定义资源
fields.name: source

fields.help_en: The ID of the target expert suite. The suite must be one that the current caller has permissions to reference
fields.help_zh: 目标专家套件 ID，必须为当前调用者有权引用的套件
fields.name: suite_id

fields.help_en: The published integer version number of the custom expert suite, used to explicitly select an existing version. Do not pass this field when Source is set to OFFICIAL. This parameter is mutually exclusive with VersionSelector. To obtain explicit and reproducible references, do not rely on the default selection when the version is omitted
fields.help_zh: 自定义专家套件的已发布整数版本号，用于明确选择已有版本。Source=OFFICIAL 时不要传此字段；不与 VersionSelector 同时传入。为获得明确可复现的引用，不依赖省略版本时的默认选择
fields.name: version

fields.help_en: The semantic version selection expression of the custom expert suite, such as ^1.2.3. Use this parameter only when the target server has deployed the custom resource version selection capability. This parameter is mutually exclusive with Version. This field is not accepted when Source is set to OFFICIAL. To ensure compatibility with servers of unconfirmed versions, use an existing integer Version
fields.help_zh: 自定义专家套件的语义版本选择表达式，例如 ^1.2.3。仅在目标服务端已部署自定义资源版本选择能力时使用，与 Version 互斥。Source=OFFICIAL 时不接受此字段。需要兼容未确认版本的服务端时，使用已有的整数 Version
fields.name: version_selector

parameters.help_en: The list of expert suite references. If omitted, the existing references are retained. An explicit empty array clears the references. For official suites, specify only Source=OFFICIAL and SuiteId. Version, VersionSelector, or client artifact fields are not accepted. For custom suites, use SuiteId, and you can explicitly specify an existing integer Version
parameters.help_zh: 专家套件引用列表。省略保留；显式空数组清空引用。官方套件只填写 Source=OFFICIAL 和 SuiteId，不接受 Version、VersionSelector 或客户端制品字段。自定义套件使用 SuiteId，可显式指定已有的整数 Version
parameters.name: expert_suites

fields.help_en: The name of the called sub-agent. The agent must be one that the current caller has permissions to use
fields.help_zh: 被调用的子 Agent 名称，必须为当前调用者有权使用的 Agent
fields.name: name

parameters.help_en: The list of callable sub-agent references. Non-empty references must be visible, and cannot reference themselves or form call loops. Omit this parameter if no modification is required. Do not use an empty array to express general retention or clearing semantics
parameters.help_zh: 可调用的子 Agent 引用列表。非空引用必须可见，不能引用自身或形成调用环。不需要修改时省略本参数，不用空数组表达通用的保留或清空语义
parameters.name: callable_agents

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to publish the agent immediately after the update. Valid values: true: saves a new draft version before requesting publication. false or omitted: saves only the definition. Saving and publishing are not atomic operations. If the operation fails, call GetAgent to read the current version before retrying to avoid blindly repeating the update
parameters.help_zh: 是否更新后立即发布。true：先保存新草稿版本再请求发布；false 或省略：只保存定义。保存与发布不是原子操作，失败后先 GetAgent 回读当前版本，不盲目重复更新
parameters.name: publish_immediately

parameters.help_en: The extended metadata. If omitted, the existing metadata is retained. If provided, the business metadata is updated, and the server retains the protected system metadata
parameters.help_zh: 扩展元数据。省略时保留；传入时更新业务元数据，服务端保留受保护的系统元数据
parameters.name: metadata

parameters.help_en:
The visibility level.
TENANT: visible within the account.
PROJECT: visible to specified projects.
USER: visible to specified users
parameters.help_zh:
可见性级别。
`TENANT`：账号内可见；
`PROJECT`：指定项目可见；
`USER`：指定用户可见
parameters.name: visibility

fields.help_en: The list of visible project IDs. This parameter takes effect when Visibility is set to PROJECT
fields.help_zh: 可见的项目 ID 列表，Visibility 为 `PROJECT` 时生效
fields.name: project_ids

fields.help_en: The list of visible user IDs. This parameter is used when Visibility is set to USER
fields.help_zh: 可见用户 ID 列表，Visibility 为 USER 时使用
fields.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en: The visibility scope. The corresponding field is used based on the Visibility value
parameters.help_zh: 可见性范围，按 Visibility 取对应字段
parameters.name: visibility_scope

schema.description_en: The agent update response, which contains the updated agent definition and the OpenAPI request ID
schema.description_zh: Agent 更新响应，包含更新后的 Agent 定义和 OpenAPI 请求 ID

Agent.description_en: The details of the updated agent

AgentVersion.description_zh: 更新后的 Agent 定义版本
AgentVersion.title_en: 更新后的 Agent 定义版本
AgentVersion.title_zh: 更新后的 Agent 定义版本

Description.description_en: The suite description of the bound version
Description.example: 数据分析专家能力集合

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the bound version

Name.description_en: The suite name of the bound version

SemanticVersion.description_en: The semantic version of the bound version

Source.description_en: The source of the expert suite

SuiteId.description_en: The ID of the expert suite

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The time when the agent was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
GmtCreateTime.description_zh: Agent 创建时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

GmtModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the agent was last modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
GmtModifiedTime.description_zh: Agent 最近修改时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

Skills.description_en: The list of bound skill references after the update
Skills.description_zh: 更新后绑定的 Skill 引用列表

Name.description_en: The name of the bound custom skill
Name.description_zh: 绑定的自定义 Skill 名称

Version.description_en: The published version number of the bound custom skill
Version.description_zh: 绑定的自定义 Skill 发布版本号
